sql: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT current_database() as db, current_user as actor, exists(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='operation_evidence' AND column_name='declared_md5') as amended, to_regprocedure('public.haven_custom_access_token_hook(jsonb)') IS NOT NULL as hook_exists) q;
